# deployment

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/observers/deployment"
```

Package deployment re\-exports the deployment\-observer reconciler type as a public alias. The reconciler itself stays in internal/controller/observers/deployment, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct it against.

<a name="Reconciler"></a>
## type Reconciler

Reconciler observes Flux Kustomization resources and feeds their terminal reconciliation outcome back to the owning Deployment CR.

```go
type Reconciler = internaldeployment.Reconciler
```
